title: Shared Fabric-backed FA3 Plugin & Extension Manager
rationale: Reuse FA3-SHARED-PLUGIN-EXTENSION-FABRIC-001 as the single plugin/extension manifest, binding and AI-policy source.
Avoid duplicate per-application plugin managers and state drift.
Keep trust/admission, resources, routing, secrets, workflow and evidence in existing authorities.
Allow plugin and extension management without starting the target application.
Apply the shared manager entry retroactively to every functionally affected FA3 GUI application.
